headline.text: L1 S3 metal detector caught *metal fragment* embedded in chocolate coating — investigation open, source unknown.

summary: Three metal-related events within 24 hours: L1 S3 metal fragment in product (caught by detector, source under investigation), L1 S2 screw+washer found on M6 belt (X-ray rejected pouches but none contained metal, source identified), L3 ML4 metal on screen (caught at sweco, no line impact). L2 ML2 running with non-adhesive film — 4 bad rolls pulled.

food_safety.title: Gasket pieces found in S2 caramel system
food_safety.summary: Gasket pieces discovered in caramel line; all caramel drained, kettles cleaned and rinsed, cooking restarted after 2-hour pause.
food_safety.status: Resolved — line restarted after drain, clean, and rinse at 13:46 MT.

food_safety.title: Screw with washer found on S2 M6 pass belt
food_safety.summary: Screw and washer fell onto floor from M6 pass belt; X-ray rejected some pouches but inspection confirmed none contained metal; source identified as cover on C11 belt.
food_safety.status: Resolved — source found and secured, no metal in rejected product.

food_safety.title: Metal fragment found embedded in chocolate coating on S3 jar line
food_safety.summary: Product dropped during metal-detector card verification re-tested and triggered detector; search found magnetic metal fragment inside chocolate coating — metal detector caught it, investigation ongoing with maintenance to identify source.
food_safety.status: Open, awaiting maintenance investigation to identify metal source.

food_safety.title: Metal piece found on ML4 screen check
food_safety.summary: Metal found on southwest side of screen during routine check; caught at sweco before product contact, line continued running while Kevin Del Valle investigates source.
food_safety.status: Investigation ongoing — sweco effective, no product hold required.

food_safety.title: Wire mesh broken at corner on Truffle bottomer
food_safety.summary: Wire mesh on bottomer enrober broke at one corner; concern it could catch in detailer and break completely; maintenance requested for repair.
food_safety.status: Open, awaiting maintenance repair to prevent full failure.

quality.title: Non-adhesive film on ML2 flow-wrap line
quality.summary: Film without proper glue caused open wraps throughout 2nd and 3rd shift; 4 rolls total removed (2 rolls 2nd shift, 2 rolls 1st shift); samples saved for supplier review.
quality.status: Resolved — bad rolls removed, line running on good film, samples held for Ethan Bean.

quality.title: FFS long sealer heating pad detached twice in 30 minutes
quality.summary: Heating pad on long sealer came off, maintenance fixed, then detached again within 30 minutes; second repair held.
quality.status: Resolved — line running after second repair at 21:06 MT.

quality.title: Sorter visual inspection failed
quality.summary: Small reject conveyor on sorter failed visual inspection check; QA notified, awaiting disposition.
quality.status: Open, pending QA disposition on sorter reject area.

sanitation.title: White powder from S2 return belt rubbing on door
sanitation.summary: Return conveyor belt #2 rubbing against door generated white powder; maintenance adjusted belt tracking, production cleaned area, ATP test passed.
sanitation.status: Resolved — ATP passed after cleaning and belt adjustment at 15:13 MT.

sanitation.title: S4 drain cleaning documentation gap clarified
sanitation.summary: Question raised whether 3rd shift completed drain cleaning after 2nd shift ended production Friday 10:20 PM; operator entered in SafetyChain, MSS filled by supervisor.
sanitation.status: Resolved — documentation confirmed complete in SafetyChain and MSS.

opportunities.text: Consider adding equipment-integrity checks (bolts, covers, gaskets) to S2 and S3 startup checklists — based on today's gasket fragments in caramel, screw on M6 belt, and metal fragment in S3 product.
Review film supplier QC or incoming inspection for adhesive coverage — based on 4 rolls with insufficient glue across ML2 over 18 hours.
Consider adding wire-mesh condition check to ML4 and Truffle bottomer pre-shift inspections — based on today's broken corner on Truffle bottomer with risk of detailer damage.
